text: ３のしまって　ここだけ　かよ？

patterns.name: 〜って (topic)
patterns.explanation: って after a word brings it up as the thing being talked about, like a casual は. ３のしまって = 'this Three Island, is it'.

patterns.name: 〜かよ
patterns.explanation: かよ is a rough question ending that shows disbelief or disgust. ここだけかよ = 'this is all there is?!'
